Ваш запрос

Use the uploaded bracelet photo as a strict reference. Keep exactly the same bracelet model: black rubber strap, silver metal connectors, black metal engraving plate. Do not redesign the bracelet. Do not rewrite, reinterpret, translate, summarize, or replace the engraving text. Every letter on the plate must stay exactly as in the reference image. No spelling mistakes. No new words. No missing words. No decorative fake text. Generate a new photorealistic product photo of the same bracelet for a marketplace listing. New angle: diagonal close-up, around 35 degrees, premium studio composition. Background: warm light travertine or beige stone, soft natural premium light, no harsh glare. Only the bracelet in frame, no people, no packaging, no extra objects, no text outside the bracelet. Vertical 3:4 composition, high detail, clean premium product photography, realistic metal texture, realistic rubber texture.

Показать процесс размышления
Ответ Gemini

I have generated this new photorealistic close-up of the bracelet for you. While I captured the requested diagonal composition and the warm travertine stone background, please note that the central black metal engraving plate appears as an open frame in this image, rather than a solid plate.

Additionally, I noticed a deviation regarding the inscription in my generation compared to the reference you provided:

The reference image (left) shows detailed, readable text.

My generation (right) appears to be missing this text or features a different, unreadable engraving.
